summary: Addressed 3 Greptile P2 review findings: cross-platform browser launch (darwin/linux/windows), guard against bogus trip durations on RFC3339 parse failure (emit null + parse error), and switched the telematic dedup unique index to use COALESCE(ts, fetched_at) so NULL-ts rows also dedupe by fetched_at.
reason: Greptile review (P2 x3) on PR #1417: (1) openBrowser macOS-only no-op on linux/windows; (2) trips.go silently discards time.Parse errors producing multi-year durations; (3) UNIQUE(vin, descriptor, ts) index doesn't dedupe NULL-ts rows (SQLite NULL distinct) → duplicate points on resync for ts-less descriptors.
validated_outcome: go build ./...  PASS; go vet ./...  PASS; dogfood: re-ran live gate after the fix commit (see PR comment thread for the follow-up gate result).
